mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in residential investment (RSAFS) signals robust housing market activity that correlates with elevated consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises month-over-month, or the rank IC between RSAFS and returns falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds rate below 0.10% for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary easing that compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS has been below 0.10% for two consecutive months, or the rank IC between FEDFUNDS and returns is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal a tightening labor market that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction term (UNRATE decline * PAYEMS increase) has a rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 104.0) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 104.0, or the rank IC between INDPRO and returns is above -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually signals persistent inflation that typically leads to higher real interest rates and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% annually, or the rank IC between CPIAUCSL and returns is above -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong housing market momentum that correlates with robust consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both increase, or the interaction term (RSAFS increase * HOUST increase) has a rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.0%) for two consecutive months signals economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE has been above 6.0% for two consecutive months, or the rank IC between UNRATE and returns is above -0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO) trend consistently signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the rank IC between INDPRO and returns is above -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
